arxiv-2103-03754.title: Loschmidt Echo of Far-From-Equilibrium Fermionic Superfluids
arxiv-2103-03754.creator: Colin Rylands, Emil A. Yuzbashyan, Victor Gurarie, Aidan Zabalo, Victor Galitski
arxiv-2103-03754.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Colin Rylands, Emil A. Yuzbashyan, Victor Gurarie, Aidan Zabalo, Victor Galitski. Non-analyticities in the logarithm of the Loschmidt echo, known as dynamical quantum phase transitions [DQPTs], are a recently introduced attempt to classify the myriad of possible phenomena which can occur in far from equilibrium closed quantum systems. In this work, we analytically investigate the Loschmidt echo in nonequilibrium s s -wave and topological p x + i ​ p y p_{x}+ip_{y} fermionic superfluids.

arxiv-2212-11217.title: 4 ​ d 4d 𝒩 = 1 \,\mathcal{N}\!=\!1 dualities from 5 ​ d 5d dualities
arxiv-2212-11217.creator: Stephane Bajeot, Sergio Benvenuti
arxiv-2212-11217.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Stephane Bajeot, Sergio Benvenuti. We consider 5 ​ d 5d KK dualities, that is multiple 5 ​ d 5d gauge theories with the same 6 ​ d 6d infinite coupling limit. We provide a prescription to associate 4 ​ d 4d 𝒩 = 1 \mathcal{N}=1 quivers to the 5 ​ d 5d dual quivers, such that the 4 ​ d 4d quivers are also dual to each other.

arxiv-2402-07817.title: Injecting Wiktionary to improve token-level contextual representations using contrastive learning
arxiv-2402-07817.creator: Anna Mosolova, Marie Candito, Carlos Ramisch
arxiv-2402-07817.description: Abstract While static word embeddings are blind to context, for lexical semantics tasks context is rather too present in contextual word embeddings, vectors of same-meaning occurrences being too different Ethayarajh 2019 . Fine-tuning pre-trained language models (PLMs) using contrastive learning was proposed, leveraging automatically self-augmented examples Liu et al. 2021b .

arxiv-2403-14625.title: LiFT: A Surprisingly Simple Lightweight Feature Transform for Dense ViT Descriptors
arxiv-2403-14625.creator: Saksham Suri** Matthew Walmer** Kamal Gupta Abhinav Shrivastava
arxiv-2403-14625.description: Abstract We present a simple self-supervised method to enhance the performance of ViT features for dense downstream tasks. Our Lightweight Feature Transform (LiFT) is a straightforward and compact postprocessing network that can be applied to enhance the features of any pre-trained ViT backbone.

arxiv-2409-04815.title: Carbon nanotube as quantum point contact valley-filter and valley-splitter
arxiv-2409-04815.creator: N. A. Hadadi, A. Belayadi, Ousmane Ly, A. Abbout
arxiv-2409-04815.description: Abstract The electrical characteristics of a carbon nanotube can be significantly modified by applying elastic strain. This study focuses on exploring this phenomenon in a single-walled carbon nanotube (SWNT) using tight-binding transport calculations. The results indicate that, under specific strains, an armchair SWNT can act as a filter, separating the two valley electrons K and K ′ .

arxiv-2503-05873.title: Coding-Based Hybrid Post-Quantum Cryptosystem for Non-Uniform Information Thanks: Parts of this work were accepted for publication at the IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory, ISIT 2024.
arxiv-2503-05873.creator: Saar Tarnopolsky and Alejandro Cohen
arxiv-2503-05873.description: Abstract We introduce for non-uniform messages a novel hybrid universal network coding cryptosystem (NU-HUNCC) in the finite blocklength regime that provides Post-Quantum (PQ) security at high communication rates. Recently, hybrid cryptosystems offered PQ security by premixing the data using secure linear coding schemes and encrypting only a small portion of it.

arxiv-2506-16238.creator: Anupam Datta , Michael Joachim
arxiv-2506-16238.description: Abstract We cast Kasparov’s equivariant KK-theory in the framework of model categories. arxiv-2508-09997.title: Thematic and Task-Based Categorization of K-12 GenAI Usages with Hierarchical Topic Modeling Thanks: Accepted at the International Conference on Computer-Human Interaction Research and Applications (CHIRA), 2025; Cite as: Schneider, J., Hasler, B. S., Varrone, M., Hoya, F., Schroffenegger, T., Mah,
arxiv-2508-09997.creator: Johannes Schneider, Béatrice S. Hasler, Michaela Varrone, Fabian Hoya, Thomas Schroffenegger, Dana-Kristin Mah, Karl Peböck
arxiv-2508-09997.description: Abstract We analyze anonymous interaction data of minors in class-rooms spanning several months, schools, and subjects employing a novel, simple topic modeling approach. Specifically, we categorize more than 17,000 messages generated by students, teachers, and ChatGPT in two dimensions: content (such as nature and people) and tasks (such as writing and explaining).

arxiv-2601-20293.title: Model independent test of the FLRW metric and the curvature in light of DESI DR2
arxiv-2601-20293.creator: Marian Douspis
arxiv-2601-20293.description: Abstract We perform a data-driven test of the FLRW metric and the flatness of the Universe, independently of any Dark Energy model, and in light of the latest DESI DR2 results. We use Pantheon+ and DESY5 SNIa data to reconstruct the distance modulus, dimensionless comoving distance and Hubble parameter, using an iterative smoothing algorithm.

pmc-10568727.title: Performance and Emission Analysis of Biodiesel Blends in a Low Heat Rejection Engine with an Antioxidant Additive: An Experimental Study
pmc-10568727.creator: Elumalai Perumal Venkatesan, Silambarasan Rajendran, Manickam Murugan, Sreenivasa Reddy Medapati, Keerty Venkata Sri Ramachandra Murthy, Mamdooh Alwetaishi, Sher Afghan Khan, Chanduveetil Ahamed Saleel
pmc-10568727.description: The rapid depletion of crude oil and environmental degradation necessitate the search for alternative fuel sources for internal combustion engines. Biodiesel is a promising alternative fuel for compression ignition (CI) engines due to its heat content and combustion properties. Biodiesel blends are used in various vehicles and equipment, such as cars, trucks, buses, off-road vehicles, and oil furnaces.

pmc-11382052.title: Daily koumiss has positive regulatory effects on blood lipids and immune system: A metabolomics study
pmc-11382052.creator: Leqi Wang, Yuanfang Sun, Lijing Du, Qian Wang, Min Zhan, Shasha Li, Xue Xiao
pmc-11382052.description: Koumiss, a traditional Mongolian beverage, is believed to possess high nutritional value and potential medical benefits. However, there is a lack of comprehensive research on its potential impact on the human body. Metabolomics, as a sensitive approach in systems biology, offers a new avenue for studying the overall effects of koumiss.

pmc-11439639.title: Osteopoikilosis in a young ankylosing spondylitis patient
pmc-11439639.creator: Vitaly Omelchenko, Elena Letyagina, Maxim Korolev
pmc-11439639.description: Osteopoikilosis (OPK) is a rare benign congenital genetic-mediated sclerosing skeletal disease, characterized by the formation of osteosclerosis foci. OPK is usually clinically asymptomatic, but some patients (15%~20%) may have arthralgia and synovitis. OPK may be associated with rheumatic diseases and might lead to unreasonable over-examination in real clinical practice.

pmc-11456593.title: Wild rodent fleas carrying Bartonella and Rickettsia in an area endemic for vector-borne diseases from Argentina
pmc-11456593.creator: M Fernanda López Berrizbeitia, Diana B Acosta, Juliana P Sanchez
pmc-11456593.description: Vector-borne diseases account for nearly 20% of all globally recognised infectious diseases. Within the spectrum of flea-borne pathogens, Bartonella and Rickettsia bacteria are prominent, contributing to the emergence and resurgence of diseases on a global scale. This study investigates the presence of species of Bartonella and Rickettsia harboured by fleas collected from wild rodents in northwestern Argentina (NWA).

pmc-12464559.title: ﻿Colletotrichum macroconidii sp. nov. and six new records of Colletotrichum (Glomerellaceae, Glomerellales) from southwestern China
pmc-12464559.creator: Chada Norphanphoun, Meng-Ting Zou, Feng-Quan Liu, Yong Wang
pmc-12464559.description: ﻿AbstractColletotrichum, a genus in the phylum Ascomycota and the family Glomerellaceae, is globally recognized as a significant plant pathogen affecting various hosts. In this study, 31 Colletotrichum strains were isolated from plant hosts in southwestern China, specifically from Guizhou and Yunnan Provinces. Phylogenetic and morphological analyses revealed one novel species, Colletotrichum macroconidiisp. nov., and 11 previously known species.

pmc-12621587.title: Postoperative Serum NLRP1 as a Biochemical Predictor of Delirium and Cognitive Decline After Hip Fracture Surgery in Elderly Patients: A Single Center Observational Study
pmc-12621587.creator: Liuqing Wu, Yu Li, Li Li, Guangjie Pan, Yali You, Xingchi Chen, Xiaoting Ren
pmc-12621587.description: ObjectivePostoperative delirium (POD) and cognitive decline (POCD) are linked to inflammatory brain injury, and nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-like receptor family pyrin domain-containing 1 (NLRP1) participates in neuroinflammation. Here, we investigated influential factors of serum NLRP1 levels and its predictive significance on POD and POCD of elderly patients with hip fracture.

pmc-12656545.title: Third Booster Half Dose of ChAdOx1-nCov-19 Is Effective, Safe, and Induces Long-Duration Humoral and Cellular Immune Response to Omicron: 1-Year Follow-Up of Viana Study
pmc-12656545.creator: Nésio Fernandes de Medeiros-Junior, Maria da Penha Gomes Gouvea, Luiz Antônio Bastos Camacho, Daniel Antunes Maciel Villela, Sheila Maria Barbosa de Lima, Waleska Dias Schwarcz, Adriana Souza Azevedo, Lauro Ferreira Pinto Neto, Carla Magda Allan Santos Domingues, Rosilene Nilo dos Santos Fantoni, Lu
pmc-12656545.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Dose-sparing approaches can be effective in maintaining immunogenicity and safety while expanding vaccine coverage. We previously demonstrated that a half dose of ChAdOx1 nCoV-19 is as effective and immunogenic for primary vaccination. Methods: This non-inferiority, non-randomized controlled trial evaluated the effectiveness, humoral, and cellular immune responses of a third booster dose—comparing half-dose and full-dose regimens—in individuals aged 18–49 years, with a 1-year follow-up. Results: A total of 2801 participants were enrolled: 2352 received half doses and 449 received full doses.

pmc-12773406.title: Abstract 105: Limb Shaking Transient Ischemic Attack: A Rare Presentation of Internal Carotid Artery Occlusion
pmc-12773406.creator: Francesca Pastrana, Wilson Rodriguez, Divya Singh, Hanan Qaqish, Brian Miremadi
pmc-12773406.description: IntroductionLimb‐shaking transient ischemic attack (LS‐TIA) is a rare disorder characterized by brief, irregular, involuntary movements of the extremities with or without loss of consciousness. Associated paroxysmal hyperkinetic extremity movements often described by patients as “shaking,” “tremors,” or “twitching” are an uncommon and under‐reported presentation of cerebral hypoperfusion.

pmc-13254955.title: Percutaneous antegrade-retrograde recanalization (rendezvous technique) of a complete ureteropelvic junction disruption after robotic-assisted partial nephrectomy: A case report
pmc-13254955.creator: Motoki Fujita, Toshiki Kijima, Hirotaka Fuchizawa, Gaku Nakamura, Toshitaka Uematsu, Kohei Takei, Shigeyoshi Soga, Takao Kamai
pmc-13254955.description: Urinary fistula is a known complication of partial nephrectomy (PN), but complete disruption of the ureteropelvic junction (UPJ) is extremely rare. Surgical reconstruction in a post-operative field is challenging due to scarring and adhesions. We present a case of complete UPJ disruption following robotic-assisted partial nephrectomy (RAPN) that was successfully managed with a minimally invasive interventional radiology (IVR) technique.

pmc-13609500.creator: Hezhou Chen, Bohan Xu, Qidi Xie, Zhen Gu, Shaozhuang Guo, Shuqin Chen
pmc-13609500.description: Water diversion projects can alleviate the uneven spatiotemporal distribution of water resources, but they may also impact functions of aquatic ecosystems in the waters along the route.
